name: vault.check_in.answer
description: A person pinned on a pending check-in's current rung approves or denies the exact effect it waits on, on their own human proof; the first answer settles it, and the same answer again returns that settlement.
grant_class: the answering person's own human credential, pinned on the ask's current rung, with a live Grant (or the owner role) whose own check-in admits the act
